subject: RM_VenomvineThicket
departures: built from long horizontal vine runners stacked one over another, not upright arching canes growing from a central root crown
runners matted and woven into one solid chest-high mass with no gaps between separate plants, like a living wall
interior completely black and lightless where it shows, with no light coming through the tangle
thorns along the runners beaded or wet with venomvine sap
no berries, flowers or open sprays of foliage; the vine-thorn tangle is the whole visible plant
